coordination:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game UI technology research icon, a single square transparent PNG.
Primary request: a polished, premium military science-fiction RTS icon representing COORDINATION: one central beveled command processor linked by three thick circuit arms to three satellite nodes. Make a strong simple symmetrical silhouette that reads instantly at 32 by 32 pixels.
Style: crafted high-end 3D relief emblem, restrained realistic materials, crisp industrial design, broad readable facets. Brushed pale titanium and dark graphite recesses, a few small warm ivory illuminated insets. Consistent soft upper-left studio key light, clean edge highlights, gentle ambient occlusion. Mostly front view with very shallow depth, not isometric.
Composition: one isolated emblem centered, fills 82 percent of the square, generous transparent padding, compact mass, all meaningful strokes broad. Maximum three main forms. No tiny circuitry, no screws or micro-detail.
Constraints: genuine transparent background, no tile, no border, no frame, no backdrop, no floor, no outside glow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. This goes inside an existing dark gunmetal HUD socket; the silver silhouette must remain clear when reduced. This establishes the visual style for all research icons.
